shots.name: devices/live-01-iphone-se
shots.probe: (() => { const vis = el => { if (!el) return false; const s = getComputedStyle(el); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.width > 1 && r.height > 1; }; const pick = { topbar: '.topbar', kpis: '.kpi-wrap', left: '.panel-left', right: '.panel-right', bottom: '.live-bottom-main', dc: '.dc', water: '.watermark', zoom: '.maplibregl-ctrl-bottom-right .maplibregl-ctrl-group' }; const R = {}; for (const [k, s] of Object.entries(pick)) { const el = document.querySelector(s); if (vis(el)) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); R[k] = { l: r.left, t: Math.max(0, r.top), r: r.right, b: Math.min(innerHeight, r.bottom) }; } } const over = []; const ks = Object.keys(R); for (let i = 0; i < ks.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < ks.length; j++) { const a = R[ks[i]], b = R[ks[j]]; const w = Math.min(a.r, b.r) - Math.max(a.l, b.l), h = Math.min(a.b, b.b) - Math.max(a.t, b.t); if (w > 2 && h > 2) over.push(ks[i] + '×' + ks[j] + ' ' + Math.round(w) + 'x' + Math.round(h)); } const trunc = [...document.querySelectorAll('.stat-tile .st-label, .tm-time, .zl-name, .st-text')].filter(e => vis(e) && e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 1).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const off = ks.filter(k => R[k].l < -1 || R[k].r > innerWidth + 1).map(k => k + ' off-x'); return { vw: innerWidth, vh: innerHeight, overflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth, kpisShown: [...document.querySelectorAll('.kpi-scroll .stat-tile')].filter(vis).length, moreRows: [...document.querySelectorAll('.ak-row')].filter(vis).length, overlaps: over, offscreen: off, truncated: trunc }; })()
